title: r5 blocker CLOSED: the effect_settings wiring pin now bites — deleting the Run->Paused flip fails odin test app (mechanically re-proven at r6)
evidence: settings_effect_wiring_pauses_on_open: `app: App; app.mode = .Run; ... effect_settings(&app, &app.input); testing.expect(t, app.mode == .Paused ...)`. settings_chip_click_pauses_end_to_end: `app.input.on_settings = effect_settings; ... swallowed := inp.settings_press(&app.input, pos)`. Mechanical check at fe233c0: deleted `am, im := settings_pause_effect(...); app.mode = am; ictx.mode = im` from effect_settings -> odin test app reports 3 failures; restored -> 18/18 pass.
detail: Both legs drive the real effect (no hook replacement, the parity-recorder trap); the chip leg wires the real effect_settings via on_settings. The r4/r5 hole is closed.

title: demolish_button_rect keeps the unscaled nil-view fallback and parity.odin:998 still calls THAT branch
evidence: popover.odin:62 `demolish_button_rect :: proc(pop: rl.Rectangle, v: ^View = nil) -> rl.Rectangle { if v != nil { return {pop.x + hud_f(v, 10), ...} } return {pop.x + 10, pop.y + pop.height - 36, ...}`; parity.odin:998 `btn := rnd.demolish_button_rect(pop)` (no view).
detail: Two geometries for one button: the app uses the scaled branch, parity the raw one — the exact divergence the single-source rule exists to prevent. At x1.25+ the parity center misses the app's drawn button.
recommended_fix: Make the view required (parity.odin:986 already passes one at the other call site); delete the raw fallback.

title: AUDIO row still not persisted though effect_settings_adjust routes every row through settings_save
evidence: `case rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO: au.toggle_mute(&app.audio) } settings_save(app.a11y)` — A11y_Settings{palette, reduced_motion, scale_step} has no mute byte.
detail: The save call after the audio toggle persists nothing about mute; mute resets on relaunch while the other three rows survive — inconsistent panel semantics.
recommended_fix: Persist the mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) or route the audio row outside settings_save and fix the copy.

title: crisis_card_width hardcodes the forecast panel's 230/10 geometry
evidence: `forecast_left := v.win_w - hud(v, 230) - hud(v, 10) // the forecast panel's left edge`
detail: Clamp math duplicates forecast.odin's card_w/pad constants; a forecast resize silently breaks the clearance invariant the new hud_test clamps.
recommended_fix: Extract shared FORECAST_W/FORECAST_PAD constants both files use.

title: Crisis-outline swell inlines the reduced-motion pin instead of routing through pulse_read
evidence: `factor := table[phase]; if v.reduced_motion { factor = 1.0 }` while view.odin:355 defines `pulse_read ... if v.reduced_motion { return 1.0 } return pulse_factor(...)`.
detail: Two seams for the same E9.2 contract; a future pulse-envelope change must remember both. The comment even cites pulse_read while not using it.
recommended_fix: Route the outline's factor through pulse_read (or a shared envelope helper).

title: sla_row_rect leaves x=8 / width=740 unscaled in an otherwise hud()-scaled pass
detail: Hit width stops short of scaled text extent at x1.50 — focus-chip rect and rows stay consistent only because both use the same raw width.
recommended_fix: hud() the x and width too.

title: QoS panel proportion-bar width still computed from raw QOS_PANEL_W/150
evidence: `bw := i32((QOS_PANEL_W - 150) * u64(caps[lane]) / max(1, total))` (panel rect is hud-scaled via qos_panel_rect)
detail: Remaining member of the r2 raw-geometry family inside an otherwise scaled panel — bar underfills the scaled panel at x1.25+.
recommended_fix: hud() the bar-area constant against the panel's scaled width.

title: mouse_map gates the same `ui` condition twice back-to-back
evidence: `if ui { inp.press_swallowed = true }` immediately followed by `if ui { // swallowed — no tray, no drag } else if inp.panel_open { ... } else { ... }`
detail: The restored base-v2 shape works, but the duplicated test reads as two independent gates; a future edit that touches one and not the other reopens blocker-2's class.
recommended_fix: Merge into one chain: `if ui { inp.press_swallowed = true } else if panel_open { } else { world }`.
carry: still present since round 3 (deliberate base-v2 shape; flagged as structure debt only)

title: Panel-closed key branch still emits Settings_Navigate for Up/Down and collects Left/Right/Enter it never maps
evidence: In the panel-closed switch: `case .Up: append(out, Intent(Settings_Navigate{delta = -1}))` / `case .Down: ... delta = +1}` — executor gates these on panel_open (no-op).
detail: Collecting/map asymmetry is benign today but is a trap for a future modal (the no-op intent pair can mask a mapping bug).
recommended_fix: Gate the Up/Down mapping on inp.panel_open, or drop collection when closed.

title: Phase-1 key buffer [10]Key vs 12 collectible keys — same-frame super-chord silently drops
evidence: `keys: [10]Key` while the collect cases now include P,Space,E,S,B,M,Up,Down,Left,Right,Enter,Esc (12).
detail: Guarded appends mean silent drop, not overflow — but the 7.3 additions grew the collectible set past the buffer with no assert.
recommended_fix: Grow to [16]Key or add a debug assert on keys_n == len(keys).
